newsitem.title: USA: US sells 400 tonnes surplus lead avg. $0.3833/lb.
newsitem.headline: US sells 400 tonnes surplus lead avg. $0.3833/lb.

text.p: The U.S. Defense National Stockpile Center said Friday it sold 400 tonnes of surplus lead to three firms for an average $0.3833 per lb.
--American Iron & Metal Co, Montreal, Canada, 100 tonnes at $0.3843 per lb and 200 tonnes at $0.3831 per lb.
--MC Canfield Sons, Union, New Jersey, 60 tonnes at $0.3825 per lb.
--Lead Products Co Inc, Houston, Texas, 40 tonnes at $0.3826 per lb.
Next bid opening for lead was set for October 3 at 1500 EDT.
